questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words:
"Ravi got the job easily because he speaks many languages."
questions.explanation: A polyglot is a person who knows and speaks several languages. A polynomial is a mathematical expression and polycentric means having many centres.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom:
"Tit for tat"
questions.explanation: 'Tit for tat' means retaliating in the same way as one has been treated, i.e., a counter attack or blow for blow.

questions.question:
Select the denotation of the underlined word:
"The archer doesn't get perturbed easily."
questions.explanation: 'Perturbed' means anxious, unsettled or agitated. 'Composed' is its opposite.

questions.question:
Tree plantation is the (I) ______ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (II) ______. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (III) ______! Not only is it (IV) ______ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (V) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (I).
questions.explanation: Tree plantation is a process (a series of actions) of transplanting saplings or seeds.

questions.question:
Tree plantation is the (I) ______ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (II) ______. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (III) ______! Not only is it (IV) ______ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (V) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (II).
questions.explanation: Planting trees promotes afforestation, i.e., creating forest cover. Deforestation is the opposite.

questions.question:
Tree plantation is the (I) ______ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (II) ______. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (III) ______! Not only is it (IV) ______ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (V) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (III).
questions.explanation: 'A rewarding and fruitful endeavour' (an attempt or undertaking) is the natural collocation here.

questions.question:
Tree plantation is the (I) ______ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (II) ______. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (III) ______! Not only is it (IV) ______ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (V) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (IV).
questions.explanation: Trees are ecologically beneficial for the planet as they maintain environmental balance.

questions.question:
Tree plantation is the (I) ______ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (II) ______. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (III) ______! Not only is it (IV) ______ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (V) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (V).
questions.explanation: Trees help reduce the concentration (amount present) of pollutants in the air.

questions.question: 'अवधी बोली' का अन्य नाम है:
questions.explanation: अवधी को प्राचीन कोसल प्रदेश के नाम पर 'कोसली' भी कहा जाता है। बनाफरी बुंदेली की तथा बैगानी छत्तीसगढ़ी की उपबोली है।

questions.question: ऐसी कौन-सी दो मात्राएँ हैं जिनका प्रयोग तो किया जाता है किंतु उनका समावेश 'स्वर' में नहीं किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: अं (अनुस्वार) और अः (विसर्ग) अयोगवाह कहलाते हैं। इनका प्रयोग होता है परंतु इन्हें न स्वर में गिना जाता है न व्यंजन में।

questions.question: अनुनासिक का संबंध होता है:
questions.explanation: अनुनासिक (चंद्रबिंदु) ध्वनि के उच्चारण में वायु मुख और नासिका दोनों से निकलती है, जैसे: आँख, चाँद।

questions.question: 'प्रत्यक्ष' शब्द में उपसर्ग है:
questions.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष = प्रति + अक्ष (यण संधि)। अतः इसमें 'प्रति' उपसर्ग है।

questions.question: "चीनी, मद्रासी, बिहारी" आदि शब्द कौन-सा विशेषण हैं?
questions.explanation: ये शब्द किसी स्थान (चीन, मद्रास, बिहार) से संबंध बताते हैं, अतः ये गुणवाचक विशेषण के स्थानबोधक भेद हैं।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित शब्दों में से संज्ञा को पहचानिए:
questions.explanation: 'अनुशासन' भाववाचक संज्ञा है। नियमित, पाश्चात्य और सामाजिक विशेषण हैं।

questions.question: दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'विधुर' का स्त्रीलिंग कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: 'विधुर' (जिसकी पत्नी मर गई हो) का स्त्रीलिंग 'विधवा' है। यह नित्य पुल्लिंग-स्त्रीलिंग युग्म है।

questions.question: इनमें स्त्रीलिंग शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: 'ख्याति' स्त्रीलिंग है (उसकी ख्याति फैल गई)। पर्वत, मोती और पानी पुल्लिंग हैं; मोती और पानी ई-कारांत होने पर भी पुल्लिंग हैं।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से "आकाश" शब्द से बनने वाला विशेषण क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: आकाश + ईय प्रत्यय = आकाशीय (विशेषण)। आकाशगंगा संज्ञा (समस्त पद) है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में सही सकर्मक क्रिया का उदाहरण पहचानिए:
questions.explanation: 'सीता वीणा बजा रही है' में क्रिया 'बजाना' का कर्म 'वीणा' है, अतः यह सकर्मक क्रिया है। उगना, हँसना, सोना अकर्मक हैं।

questions.question: इनमें से किस वाक्य में अकर्मक क्रिया है?
questions.explanation: 'हँसना' क्रिया का कोई कर्म नहीं है, अतः 'श्याम हँसता है' में अकर्मक क्रिया है। अन्य वाक्यों में स्वेटर, खाना, पत्र कर्म हैं।

questions.question: 'वह एक सप्ताह बाद आया' इस वाक्य में कौन-सा शब्द क्रिया-विशेषण है?
questions.explanation: 'बाद' शब्द 'आया' क्रिया के समय की विशेषता बताता है, अतः यह कालवाचक क्रिया-विशेषण है। 'वह' सर्वनाम, 'एक' विशेषण और 'आया' क्रिया है।

questions.question: 'सदा सच बोलना चाहिए' यह किस प्रकार का वाक्य भेद है?
questions.explanation: दिए गए स्रोत के अनुसार उत्तर 'इच्छावाचक' है, क्योंकि वाक्य में वक्ता की इच्छा/कामना (सच बोलने की अपेक्षा) व्यक्त हो रही है।

questions.question: 'वह स्त्री जिसका पति परदेश (विदेश) गया हो' - वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द है:
questions.explanation: प्रोषितपतिका: जिसका पति परदेश गया हो। प्रवत्स्यत्पतिका: जिसका पति परदेश जाने वाला हो। आगतपतिका: जिसका पति परदेश से लौटा हो। नवोढ़ा: नवविवाहिता।

questions.question: 'सदा एक समान' रहने पर प्रयुक्त लोकोक्ति है:

options.D: भागते चोर की लंगोटी ही सही

questions.explanation: 'सावन हरे न भादों सूखे' का अर्थ है सदा एक-सी स्थिति में रहना।

questions.question: 'शुक्र करना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'शुक्र करना' का अर्थ है धन्यवाद देना या एहसान मानना।

questions.question: इनमें से कौन-सा तत्पुरुष समास है?
questions.explanation: आशातीत = आशा से अतीत (अपादान तत्पुरुष)। शीतोष्ण द्वंद्व, अष्टाध्यायी द्विगु और नीलकंठ बहुव्रीहि/कर्मधारय है।

questions.question:
बैंक में किसी भी प्रकार का खाता खोलने के लिए (26)______ जाकर एक फार्म भरना होता है। इस फार्म पर (27)______ के रूप में किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के (28)______ भी करवाने पड़ते हैं जिसका पहले से बैंक में खाता हो। यदि ऐसा सम्भव न हो तो बैंक के (29)______ राशन कार्ड आदि देखकर सन्तुष्ट होने पर भी खाता खोल देते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इस फार्म या अलग से एक कार्ड पर खाता खोलने के लिए दो या तीन (30)______ हस्ताक्षर करवाये जाते हैं।

रिक्त स्थान (26) के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: खाता खोलने के लिए व्यक्ति को 'स्वयं' जाकर फार्म भरना होता है।

questions.question:
बैंक में किसी भी प्रकार का खाता खोलने के लिए (26)______ जाकर एक फार्म भरना होता है। इस फार्म पर (27)______ के रूप में किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के (28)______ भी करवाने पड़ते हैं जिसका पहले से बैंक में खाता हो। यदि ऐसा सम्भव न हो तो बैंक के (29)______ राशन कार्ड आदि देखकर सन्तुष्ट होने पर भी खाता खोल देते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इस फार्म या अलग से एक कार्ड पर खाता खोलने के लिए दो या तीन (30)______ हस्ताक्षर करवाये जाते हैं।

रिक्त स्थान (27) के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: फार्म पर किसी खाताधारक को 'गवाह' (परिचयकर्ता) के रूप में हस्ताक्षर करने होते हैं।

questions.question:
बैंक में किसी भी प्रकार का खाता खोलने के लिए (26)______ जाकर एक फार्म भरना होता है। इस फार्म पर (27)______ के रूप में किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के (28)______ भी करवाने पड़ते हैं जिसका पहले से बैंक में खाता हो। यदि ऐसा सम्भव न हो तो बैंक के (29)______ राशन कार्ड आदि देखकर सन्तुष्ट होने पर भी खाता खोल देते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इस फार्म या अलग से एक कार्ड पर खाता खोलने के लिए दो या तीन (30)______ हस्ताक्षर करवाये जाते हैं।

रिक्त स्थान (28) के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: गवाह के 'हस्ताक्षर' करवाने पड़ते हैं; 'करवाने पड़ते हैं' के साथ यही शब्द उपयुक्त है।

questions.question:
बैंक में किसी भी प्रकार का खाता खोलने के लिए (26)______ जाकर एक फार्म भरना होता है। इस फार्म पर (27)______ के रूप में किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के (28)______ भी करवाने पड़ते हैं जिसका पहले से बैंक में खाता हो। यदि ऐसा सम्भव न हो तो बैंक के (29)______ राशन कार्ड आदि देखकर सन्तुष्ट होने पर भी खाता खोल देते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इस फार्म या अलग से एक कार्ड पर खाता खोलने के लिए दो या तीन (30)______ हस्ताक्षर करवाये जाते हैं।

रिक्त स्थान (29) के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: राशन कार्ड आदि देखकर संतुष्ट होने और खाता खोलने का निर्णय बैंक के 'अधिकारी' लेते हैं।

questions.question:
बैंक में किसी भी प्रकार का खाता खोलने के लिए (26)______ जाकर एक फार्म भरना होता है। इस फार्म पर (27)______ के रूप में किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के (28)______ भी करवाने पड़ते हैं जिसका पहले से बैंक में खाता हो। यदि ऐसा सम्भव न हो तो बैंक के (29)______ राशन कार्ड आदि देखकर सन्तुष्ट होने पर भी खाता खोल देते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इस फार्म या अलग से एक कार्ड पर खाता खोलने के लिए दो या तीन (30)______ हस्ताक्षर करवाये जाते हैं।

रिक्त स्थान (30) के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: खाता खोलते समय दो या तीन नमूना (प्रतिरूप) हस्ताक्षर करवाये जाते हैं।

questions.question: What was the demand of the Tebhaga peasant movement of Bengal?

options.A: Reducing the share of landlords from half of the crop to one-third
options.B: Grant of land ownership to the farmers as they are the actual cultivators of the land
options.C: Waiver of all agricultural loans taken from moneylenders
options.D: Abolition of zamindari system and abolition of agricultural slavery

questions.explanation: The Tebhaga movement (1946-47), led by the Bengal Provincial Kisan Sabha, demanded that sharecroppers (bargadars) keep two-thirds of the crop, reducing the jotedar's share from one-half to one-third.

questions.question: When did Swami Sahajanand Saraswati form the All India United Kisan Sabha with the demand of 'nationalisation of land and waterways'?
questions.explanation: Sahajanand Saraswati founded the Bihar Kisan Sabha (1929) and led the AIKS (1936), but formed the All India United Kisan Sabha in 1949, shortly before his death in 1950.

questions.question: A large number of people gathered at Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar on 13 April 1919 to protest against the arrest of:

options.A: Lala Lajpat Rai and Bal Gangadhar Tilak
options.B: Madan Mohan Malaviya and Mohammad Ali Jinnah
options.D: Dr. Saifuddin Kitchlew and Dr. Satyapal

questions.explanation: The crowd had gathered to protest against the arrest of local leaders Dr. Saifuddin Kitchlew and Dr. Satyapal under the Rowlatt Act.

questions.question: Who presided over the special session of the Indian National Congress held in Calcutta in September 1920, where the Non-Cooperation resolution was passed?
questions.explanation: Lala Lajpat Rai presided over the Calcutta special session (Sept 1920). C. Vijayaraghavachariar presided over the regular Nagpur session (Dec 1920) that ratified the resolution.

questions.question: The radical wing of the Congress, with Jawaharlal Nehru as one of its prominent leaders, founded the 'Independence for India League' in opposition to:
questions.explanation: In 1928 Jawaharlal Nehru and Subhas Chandra Bose formed the Independence for India League as they opposed the Nehru Report's goal of Dominion Status instead of complete independence.

questions.question: Who among the following participated in Gandhiji's Salt Satyagraha?
questions.explanation: Sarojini Naidu led the Dharasana raid, Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay broke salt laws in Bombay, and Rajkumari Amrit Kaur was imprisoned for joining the Salt March. All three took part.

questions.question: Which of the following indicates the correct chronological order of events in modern Indian history?

options.A: Jallianwala Bagh tragedy, Morley-Minto Reforms, August Offer, Gandhi-Irwin Pact
options.B: Morley-Minto Reforms, Gandhi-Irwin Pact, August Offer, Jallianwala Bagh tragedy
options.C: August Offer, Morley-Minto Reforms, Jallianwala Bagh tragedy, Gandhi-Irwin Pact
options.D: Morley-Minto Reforms, Jallianwala Bagh tragedy, Gandhi-Irwin Pact, August Offer

questions.explanation: Morley-Minto Reforms (1909), Jallianwala Bagh tragedy (1919), Gandhi-Irwin Pact (1931), August Offer (1940).

questions.question: Ramsay MacDonald's Communal Award (1932) did NOT provide separate electorates and reserved seats to:
questions.explanation: The Communal Award gave separate electorates to Muslims, Sikhs, Europeans, Indian Christians, Anglo-Indians and the Depressed Classes, but not to Buddhists.

questions.question: Damodar, Koel and Subarnarekha rivers originate from which of the following?
questions.explanation: The Damodar, Koel and Subarnarekha rivers rise in the Chotanagpur Plateau of Jharkhand.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Lake) with List-II (State):
List-I: A. Sela Lake, B. Badkhal Lake, C. Loktak Lake, D. Kaliveli Lake
List-II: 1. Arunachal Pradesh, 2. Haryana, 3. Manipur, 4. Tamil Nadu
questions.explanation: Sela Lake is near Sela Pass in Arunachal Pradesh, Badkhal Lake is in Faridabad (Haryana), Loktak Lake is in Manipur and Kaliveli Lake is in Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: 'Pusa Bold' is an improved variety of:
questions.explanation: Pusa Bold is a high-yielding mustard (rapeseed-mustard) variety developed by IARI, New Delhi.

questions.question: Which of the following states is the largest producer of copper in India?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh (Malanjkhand copper project in Balaghat) is the largest producer of copper ore in India, followed by Rajasthan (Khetri).

questions.question: Which one of the following statements is NOT correct regarding energy production and consumption in India?

options.A: Energy generation in India has shown a declining trend in the last decade.
options.B: India has the lowest per capita energy consumption in the world.
options.C: Coal is the largest source of commercial energy in India.
options.D: Non-conventional energy sources contribute less than one percent to the total commercial energy produced in India.

questions.explanation: As per the source answer key, the statement about non-conventional sources contributing less than 1% is not correct; renewable sources contribute a far larger share of India's commercial energy. Coal remains the largest source of commercial energy.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?

options.C: Jawaharlal Nehru Port - India's first fully mechanised port

questions.explanation: Chennai is an artificial harbour and not the deepest port; Visakhapatnam is the deepest landlocked and protected port. Cochin is a natural harbour, JNPT is mechanised and Kandla is a tidal port.

questions.question: There is a place in India where, if you stand on the shore, you will find that twice a day the sea water recedes by a few kilometres and then returns, and when the water recedes you can actually walk on the sea bed. Where is this unique phenomenon seen?
questions.explanation: At Chandipur beach in Balasore district (Odisha), the sea recedes up to about 5 km during ebb tide, letting visitors walk on the sea bed.

questions.question: The Golden Quadrilateral project is related to the development of:
questions.explanation: The Golden Quadrilateral, under NHDP, is a highway network connecting Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata.

questions.concept: Expansion of liquid in a flask
questions.question: On heating a mass of liquid filled in a glass flask:

options.A: The liquid level in the flask first falls slightly and then starts rising
options.B: The density of the liquid remains unchanged
options.C: The density of the liquid increases
options.D: The liquid level rises continuously from the beginning

questions.explanation: The glass flask is heated first and expands, so the level falls slightly. Then the liquid, which expands more than glass, heats up and the level rises. The density of the liquid decreases on heating.

questions.concept: Mass and weight on the moon
questions.question: On the surface of the moon:

options.A: Mass and weight are both reduced
options.B: Mass remains constant and only weight is reduced
options.C: Both mass and weight remain unchanged

questions.explanation: Mass is the quantity of matter and does not change. Weight = mg, and g on the moon is about 1/6 of Earth's, so weight decreases.

questions.question: Turning the steering wheel of a car involves:

options.B: Two forces acting in the same direction
options.C: Two forces acting along the same line in the same direction
options.D: A pair of equal forces acting in opposite directions along parallel lines (a couple)

questions.explanation: Steering is turned by a couple: two equal and opposite forces acting along parallel lines, producing rotation without translation.

questions.question: When copper oxide is heated with hydrogen, copper metal and water are formed. What happens to hydrogen in this process?
questions.explanation: CuO + H2 -> Cu + H2O. Hydrogen gains oxygen to form water, so it is oxidised, while copper oxide is reduced.

questions.question: Which of the following diffuses the fastest?

options.A: All diffuse at the same rate

questions.explanation: Gas particles have the largest intermolecular spaces and highest kinetic energy, so gases diffuse fastest.

questions.question: Which part of the female reproductive system prepares itself every month to receive and nurture the growing embryo?
questions.explanation: Every month the uterine lining thickens to receive and nourish a fertilised egg; if no fertilisation occurs it breaks down as menstruation.

questions.question: What is the role of iodised salt in the human body?

options.B: Regulating the function of the thyroid gland
options.D: Accelerating the functioning of the kidneys

questions.explanation: Iodine is needed to synthesise thyroxine. Its deficiency causes goitre, so iodised salt helps regulate thyroid function.

questions.question: Genetic traits are passed on from parents to offspring by:
questions.explanation: Genes, the units of heredity located on chromosomes, carry traits from parents to offspring (as per the source key).

questions.question: A person covers 1/8 of his journey on foot, 1/4 by bicycle and 2/5 by bus. He covers the remaining 108 km by car. Find the total length of the journey.
questions.explanation: Fraction covered before the car = 1/8 + 1/4 + 2/5 = (5 + 10 + 16)/40 = 31/40. Remaining = 9/40 of the journey = 108 km, so total = 108 x 40/9 = 480 km.

questions.question: In a class, 1/4 of the students chose to learn German. Of the remaining students, 4/5 chose Italian. Of the students left after that, 2/3 chose French and the rest chose Japanese. If 12 students chose Japanese, how many chose Italian?
questions.explanation: Let total = N. Remaining after German = 3N/4. Italian = 4/5 x 3N/4 = 3N/5. Left = 3N/20. Japanese = 1/3 x 3N/20 = N/20 = 12, so N = 240. Italian = 3/5 x 240 = 144.

questions.question: In a garden, each row has as many trees as there are rows. After 111 trees were uprooted in a storm, 10,914 trees remained in the garden. The number of rows of trees in the garden is:
questions.explanation: Total trees = 10914 + 111 = 11025 = x^2, so x = sqrt(11025) = 105 rows.

questions.question:
Find the approximate value of:
(9.99)^3.001 - (5.001)^2.999 + 4.997
Find the least number which when divided by 8, 10, 12, 24 and 36 leaves remainders 6, 8, 10, 22 and 34 respectively.
questions.explanation: In every case divisor - remainder = 2. LCM(8, 10, 12, 24, 36) = 360, so the required number = 360 - 2 = 358.

questions.concept: Sum of numbers from LCM and HCF
questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is 120 and their HCF is 10. Which of the following can be the sum of the two numbers?
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be 10a and 10b with a, b co-prime and ab = 120/10 = 12. Co-prime pairs: (1, 12) or (3, 4). Numbers 30 and 40 give sum 70 (the other pair gives 130).

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 8. If 4 is added to each number, the ratio becomes 2 : 3. Find the difference between the two numbers.
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be 5k and 8k. (5k + 4)/(8k + 4) = 2/3 gives 15k + 12 = 16k + 8, so k = 4. Numbers are 20 and 32; difference = 12.

questions.question: The average wage of 500 workers was Rs. 200. Later it was found that the wages of two workers, Rs. 80 and Rs. 220, were wrongly read as Rs. 180 and Rs. 20. Find the correct average wage.
The Indian Army participated in 'Exercise Khaan Quest 2025' held in:
questions.explanation: Khaan Quest is an annual multinational peacekeeping exercise hosted by Mongolia; its 2025 edition was held in Ulaanbaatar.

questions.question: Who became the first woman to be appointed as an Aide-de-Camp (ADC) to the President of India?
questions.explanation: Indian Navy officer Lt. Cdr. Yashasvi Solanki became the first woman ADC to the President of India in 2025.

questions.question: Where was the Indian Conservation Conference 2025 organised?
questions.explanation: The Indian Conservation Conference 2025 was held at the Wildlife Institute of India, Dehradun.

questions.question: Where will the Khelo India University Games 2025 be held?
questions.explanation: The Khelo India University Games 2025 were hosted by Rajasthan with Jaipur as the main venue (as per the source key).

questions.question: As per the source, from when will the first phase of the 16th Census of India 2027 begin?
questions.explanation: As per the source key, the first phase begins with the reference date of 1 October 2026 for the snow-bound areas (Ladakh, J&K, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand); the reference date for the rest of the country is 1 March 2027.

questions.question: In which state has Union Environment and Climate Change Minister Bhupender Yadav launched the 'Gharial Species Conservation Programme'?
questions.explanation: As per the source key, the Gharial Species Conservation Programme was launched in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: Who has been awarded the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar 2025 for Hindi?
questions.explanation: Parvati Tirkey received the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar 2025 for Hindi for her poetry collection 'Phir Ugna'.

questions.question: What will be the new base year for calculating GDP in India?
questions.explanation: MoSPI is revising the GDP base year from 2011-12 to 2022-23.

questions.question: In operating systems, a "Lightweight Process" (LWP) is an intermediate data structure that maps:

options.A: A user-level thread to a kernel-level thread
options.C: A kernel thread to a CPU register set

questions.explanation: An LWP sits between user threads and kernel threads; it appears to the user-thread library as a virtual processor on which user threads are scheduled, and each LWP is attached to a kernel thread.

questions.question: Which of the following is/are correct regarding deadlock prevention and deadlock avoidance?

options.A: Deadlock prevention works by ensuring at least one of the necessary conditions for deadlock cannot hold
options.B: Deadlock avoidance requires advance information about resource requests
options.C: Deadlock prevention is more restrictive and can result in lower resource utilisation

questions.explanation: Prevention negates one of the four Coffman conditions (restrictive, lower utilisation); avoidance (e.g., Banker's algorithm) needs advance knowledge of maximum resource needs. All three statements are correct.

questions.question: Multiversion Concurrency Control (MVCC) is a method that allows:

options.A: Readers to block writers until the read completes
options.B: Only one transaction to access the database at a time
options.C: Each writer to modify an object without blocking readers, by creating a new version of the object
options.D: All transactions to acquire an exclusive lock on the database

questions.explanation: MVCC keeps multiple versions of data items so readers see a consistent snapshot while writers create new versions; readers and writers do not block each other.

questions.question: Armstrong's axioms (reflexivity, augmentation, transitivity) are used in database theory to:

options.C: Infer all functional dependencies implied by a given set of functional dependencies

questions.explanation: Armstrong's axioms are sound and complete inference rules used to derive the closure (F+) of a set of functional dependencies.

questions.question: The CSMA/CD protocol, used in early Ethernet, required that:

options.A: A station listens to the channel before transmitting
options.B: A station listens for collisions during transmission
options.C: A station stops transmitting on detecting a collision

questions.explanation: CSMA/CD senses the carrier before sending, monitors for collisions while sending, aborts and sends a jam signal on collision, then uses binary exponential backoff.

questions.question: A "virtual circuit" network is a type of packet-switching network where:

options.A: A logical connection (path) is established before data transfer
options.B: A dedicated physical circuit is reserved end to end

questions.explanation: In virtual-circuit switching a logical path is set up first and all packets follow it in order. Independent routing describes datagram networks; a dedicated physical path describes circuit switching.

questions.question: A Fibonacci heap offers a better amortised running time than a binary heap for which operation(s)?
questions.explanation: A Fibonacci heap supports Insert, Merge and Decrease-Key in O(1) amortised time, versus O(log n), O(n) and O(log n) for a binary heap. Extract-Min is O(log n) in both.

questions.question: "Linear Programming" is a mathematical method for:

options.A: Writing programs in a linear sequence without loops
options.C: Maximising or minimising a linear objective function subject to linear equality and inequality constraints

questions.explanation: Linear programming optimises a linear objective function subject to linear constraints, e.g., using the Simplex method.

questions.question: In parsing theory, a "reduce-reduce" conflict occurs when:

options.A: Both a shift and a reduce operation are possible
options.C: The parser reaches an accept state too early
options.D: Two or more different reductions are possible for the same input symbol

questions.explanation: A reduce-reduce conflict arises when the parser can reduce by more than one production in the same state. Shift-reduce conflict is when both shift and reduce are possible.

questions.question: "Constant folding" is a compiler optimisation technique that involves:

options.A: Evaluating expressions with constant operands at compile time
options.D: Replacing a variable with its known constant value throughout the code

questions.explanation: Constant folding computes constant expressions (e.g., 2*3 -> 6) at compile time. Removing unreachable code is dead-code elimination; substituting known values is constant propagation.

questions.question: A carry-lookahead adder improves speed over a ripple-carry adder by:

options.C: Operating at a higher clock frequency
options.D: Adding bits serially, one per clock

questions.explanation: A CLA computes carries directly from generate (G) and propagate (P) signals in parallel, avoiding the carry ripple delay. It actually uses more gates.

questions.question: "Instruction-Level Parallelism" (ILP) is a measure of:

options.A: The number of processors in a system
options.B: The clock speed of the CPU
options.C: How many instructions in a program can be executed simultaneously

questions.explanation: ILP measures how many instructions can be overlapped or executed in parallel, exploited via pipelining, superscalar and out-of-order execution.

questions.question: The "Adapter" design pattern is a structural pattern used to:

options.A: Allow classes with incompatible interfaces to work together
options.B: Notify dependent objects of state changes
options.C: Ensure only one instance of a class exists
options.D: Provide an interface for creating objects

questions.explanation: Adapter converts one interface into another that clients expect. Singleton ensures one instance, Factory creates objects and Observer notifies dependents.

questions.question: "Dynamic method dispatch" is a mechanism by which:

options.A: Methods are overloaded with different parameters
options.C: The method implementation to be called is determined at runtime
options.D: The method implementation to be called is determined at compile time

questions.explanation: Dynamic method dispatch resolves a call to an overridden method at runtime based on the actual object type; it is the basis of runtime polymorphism.

questions.question: McCabe's Cyclomatic Complexity is calculated from a program's control flow graph as V(G) = E - N + 2P, where E, N and P are:
questions.explanation: In V(G) = E - N + 2P, E is the number of edges, N the number of nodes and P the number of connected components of the control flow graph.

questions.question: A key difference between a software "walkthrough" and an "inspection" is that:

options.A: Inspections are performed by executing the code
options.B: Inspections are more formal, with defined roles, preparation and metrics collection
options.C: Only walkthroughs have the author present

questions.explanation: Inspections (e.g., Fagan inspection) are formal with roles like moderator, reader and recorder plus metrics. Walkthroughs are informal and usually led by the author. Both are static techniques.

questions.question: The Kerberos protocol is a network authentication protocol that uses:

options.A: Symmetric-key cryptography and a trusted third party

questions.explanation: Kerberos uses symmetric-key cryptography and a trusted third party, the Key Distribution Center (AS + TGS), which issues tickets.

questions.question: Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) is a data encryption and decryption program that provides:
questions.explanation: PGP provides confidentiality (encryption), authentication and integrity through digital signatures, and compresses messages (ZIP) before encryption.

questions.question: A "Progressive Web App" (PWA) is application software delivered through the web that provides features like:

options.B: Being installed on the home screen

questions.explanation: PWAs use service workers and a web app manifest to support offline use, installation to the home screen and push notifications.

questions.question: A "Zero-Knowledge Proof" is a cryptographic method where one party can prove to another that:

options.A: They hold the private key by sending it encrypted
options.B: They are on a secure connection
options.C: They know a certain piece of information, without revealing the information itself

questions.explanation: In a zero-knowledge proof, the prover convinces the verifier that a statement is true without revealing anything beyond its truth.

questions.question: A "device driver" in an operating system acts as a:

options.A: Translator between the kernel and a hardware device

questions.explanation: A device driver provides a software interface that lets the OS kernel communicate with a specific hardware device.

questions.question: The nice command in UNIX/Linux is used to influence:

options.A: The number of open files of a process
options.B: The amount of memory used by a process
options.D: The CPU scheduling priority of a process

questions.explanation: nice starts a process with a modified niceness value (-20 to 19), changing its CPU scheduling priority. File permissions are changed with chmod.

questions.question: In query optimisation, a "cost-based" optimiser estimates the cost of different query plans based on:

options.A: The alphabetical order of table names
options.C: The experience of the user writing the query

questions.explanation: A cost-based optimiser uses catalog statistics (table sizes, cardinality, histograms, indexes) to estimate I/O and CPU cost. A rule-based optimiser uses fixed rules.

questions.question: A data cube operation that reduces dimensionality by selecting a single value for one dimension is:
questions.explanation: Slice fixes one dimension to a single value, producing a sub-cube with one less dimension. Dice selects ranges on two or more dimensions.

questions.question: An "Interior Gateway Protocol" (IGP) such as OSPF or EIGRP is used for routing:

options.D: Only between a host and its default gateway

questions.explanation: IGPs (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, IS-IS) route within one autonomous system. Exterior Gateway Protocols such as BGP route between autonomous systems.

questions.question: XMPP (Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol) is an open technology for:

options.D: Real-time communication such as instant messaging

questions.explanation: XMPP is an XML-based open protocol for instant messaging, presence information and real-time communication.

questions.question: A "streaming algorithm" processes its input in a single pass while using:

options.B: Very little memory compared to the size of the input
options.C: Memory equal to the full input size

questions.explanation: Streaming algorithms read data in one (or few) passes and use sublinear (often logarithmic) memory relative to input size.

questions.question: A "binomial heap" is a collection of:
questions.explanation: A binomial heap is a set of binomial trees, each obeying the heap property, with at most one tree of each order.

questions.question: "Handle pruning" is a step in which type of parsing?
questions.explanation: In bottom-up parsing the handle (right side of a production) is repeatedly reduced to its left side; this yields a rightmost derivation in reverse. Recursive descent and LL(1) are top-down.

questions.question: A directed acyclic graph (DAG) is an intermediate representation in compilers commonly used to:
questions.explanation: A DAG of a basic block shares nodes for identical computations, making it easy to detect and eliminate common subexpressions.

questions.question: "Memory interleaving" is a technique used to:

options.A: Improve performance by allowing the CPU to access multiple memory banks simultaneously
options.B: Reduce the size of each memory word

questions.explanation: Interleaving spreads consecutive addresses across several memory banks so accesses can overlap, increasing effective bandwidth.

questions.question: In digital circuits, which hazard(s) can be caused by unequal propagation delays of different signal paths?

options.B: Neither; such delays only reduce speed

questions.explanation: Unequal path delays can cause a momentary glitch when the output should stay constant (static hazard) or multiple transitions when it should change once (dynamic hazard).

questions.question: In Java generics, "type erasure" is the process where:

options.A: All types are converted to a single type at runtime by the JVM
options.B: Primitive types are boxed into wrapper classes
options.C: Type information is added at runtime
options.D: Generic type information is removed at compile time

questions.explanation: The Java compiler checks generic types and then erases them, replacing type parameters with their bounds or Object, so the bytecode carries no generic type information.

questions.question: A thread-safe implementation of the Singleton design pattern must handle:

options.B: Serialization of the instance to disk
options.D: Preventing instance creation by multiple threads at the same time

questions.explanation: Thread safety in Singleton means ensuring only one instance is created even if several threads call getInstance() concurrently, e.g., using synchronization or double-checked locking.

questions.question: The Putnam model of software estimation is an empirical model that falls into which category?
questions.explanation: The Putnam (SLIM) model, based on the Rayleigh-Norden curve, is classified as a dynamic multivariate model that relates effort to development time.

questions.question: "Stress testing" is a type of non-functional testing that evaluates a system's behaviour:

options.B: Only for correctness of business logic
options.D: At or beyond the limits of its normal operational capacity

questions.explanation: Stress testing pushes the system beyond normal capacity to observe failure and recovery. Behaviour under expected load is load testing.

questions.question: A "Man-in-the-Browser" (MITB) attack is a type of attack where:

options.B: A web browser is compromised by a Trojan that modifies web pages and transactions
options.C: A DNS server returns forged addresses

questions.explanation: In MITB, a Trojan in the victim's browser silently alters pages and transaction details. Intercepting the connection is man-in-the-middle; forged DNS is DNS spoofing.

questions.question: The Bell-LaPadula model is a security model designed to enforce:
questions.explanation: Bell-LaPadula enforces confidentiality via 'no read up, no write down'. The Biba model focuses on integrity.

questions.question: In a Kubernetes cluster, the smallest deployable unit of computing is a:
questions.explanation: A Pod is the smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes; it wraps one or more containers that share storage and network.

questions.question: "Server-Sent Events" (SSE) is a technology where:

options.A: A server automatically pushes updates to a client over HTTP
options.B: The client and server have full bidirectional communication
options.C: The browser downloads files in parallel
options.D: A client continuously polls the server for data

questions.explanation: SSE keeps an HTTP connection open so the server can push events one-way to the client. Full bidirectional communication is provided by WebSockets.

questions.question: A "spinning" or "busy-wait" semaphore is one where a process:

options.A: Sleeps for a random amount of time
options.B: Blocks while waiting for a resource
options.C: Continuously checks in a loop until the resource is available
options.D: Is terminated if the resource is unavailable

questions.explanation: A spinlock busy-waits, repeatedly testing the condition in a loop and consuming CPU. Blocking semaphores put the process to sleep instead.

questions.question: In UNIX file systems, an "inode" stores what kind of information about a file?

options.C: The path of the parent directory
options.D: Metadata such as permissions, ownership and data block locations

questions.explanation: An inode stores file metadata (type, permissions, owner, size, timestamps, link count, block pointers). The filename is stored in the directory entry.

questions.question: In database transactions, "atomicity" ensures that:

options.B: Concurrent transactions do not interfere with each other
options.C: A transaction either completes in its entirety or not at all
options.D: The database remains in a consistent state

questions.explanation: Atomicity is 'all or nothing'. Consistency, isolation and durability are the other ACID properties described by the remaining options.

questions.question: Which SQL clause is used to sort the result set of a query?
questions.explanation: ORDER BY sorts rows in ascending (ASC, default) or descending (DESC) order. GROUP BY groups rows for aggregation.

questions.question: The "Physical Layer" of the OSI model is responsible for:

options.D: The transmission of raw bits over a physical medium

questions.explanation: The physical layer transmits bits over the medium. Framing is done by the data link layer, routing by the network layer and session management by the session layer.

questions.question: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) is used to:

options.A: Map IP addresses to MAC addresses
options.C: Automatically assign IP addresses to devices on a network
options.D: Resolve domain names to IP addresses

questions.explanation: DHCP automatically assigns IP address, subnet mask, gateway and DNS. Name resolution is DNS and IP-to-MAC mapping is ARP.

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of the bubble sort algorithm?
questions.explanation: In the worst case (reverse-sorted input) bubble sort makes n(n-1)/2 comparisons, i.e., O(n^2). O(n) is its best case with the swap-flag optimisation.

questions.question: A "hash collision" occurs when:

options.A: A hash function returns an error
options.B: Two different inputs produce the same hash value
options.C: A hash value is too long
options.D: The hash table is completely empty

questions.explanation: A collision occurs when two distinct keys map to the same hash value; it is resolved by chaining or open addressing.

questions.question: Which of the following grammars is the most powerful in the Chomsky hierarchy?
questions.explanation: Type-0 (unrestricted) grammars generate recursively enumerable languages and are the most powerful. Power order: Type-0 > Type-1 > Type-2 > Type-3.

questions.question: The output of the lexical analysis phase of a compiler is a stream of:
questions.explanation: The lexical analyser groups characters into lexemes and outputs tokens to the parser. Parse trees come from syntax analysis.

questions.question: An OR gate will have a HIGH output if:

options.B: The number of inputs is even
options.C: An odd number of inputs are HIGH only

questions.explanation: An OR gate outputs 1 if at least one input is 1. Output HIGH only for an odd number of HIGH inputs describes XOR.

questions.question: The "clock rate" of a CPU is typically measured in:
questions.explanation: Clock rate is the number of cycles per second, measured in hertz (modern CPUs in GHz).

questions.question: The concept of hiding the internal implementation details of an object and exposing only the necessary functionality is called:
questions.explanation: Encapsulation bundles data and methods and restricts direct access to internal state, exposing only a public interface.

questions.question: The super keyword in Java is used to:

options.C: Refer to the current class instance
options.D: Refer to members of the immediate parent class

questions.explanation: super accesses the immediate parent class's members and constructors. this refers to the current instance and new creates objects.

questions.question: The Waterfall Model is a software development life cycle model that is:
questions.explanation: In the Waterfall model, phases proceed one after another in a linear sequence. Iterative is incremental/agile, risk-driven is the Spiral model.

questions.question: "Usability testing" primarily focuses on:

options.B: The number of bugs in the software
options.D: How easy the software is to use

questions.explanation: Usability testing evaluates ease of use, learnability and user satisfaction by observing real users.

questions.question: A "Digital Certificate" binds a public key to:

options.C: An identity (such as a person or an organisation)

questions.explanation: A digital certificate (e.g., X.509), signed by a Certificate Authority, binds a public key to the identity of its owner.

questions.question: "Phishing" is a type of social engineering attack where an attacker:

options.B: Attempts to obtain sensitive information by posing as a trustworthy entity

questions.explanation: Phishing uses fraudulent emails or websites that impersonate trusted entities to steal credentials or financial data. Flooding is a DoS attack.

questions.question: In supervised machine learning, the training data consists of:
questions.explanation: Supervised learning trains on input-output (labelled) pairs. Unlabelled data is used in unsupervised learning and rewards in reinforcement learning.

questions.question: SaaS (Software as a Service) is a cloud computing model where:

options.A: Software applications are provided to customers on a subscription basis
options.B: Raw computing infrastructure is provided to customers
options.C: A platform is provided for customers to develop applications
options.D: Customers buy perpetual licences and install software on-premises

questions.explanation: SaaS delivers ready-to-use applications over the internet (e.g., Gmail). Raw infrastructure is IaaS and a development platform is PaaS.

questions.question: The Banker's Algorithm is used for:
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's Banker's algorithm grants a request only if the system stays in a safe state, thereby avoiding deadlock.

questions.question: The SQL JOIN clause is used to:

options.D: Combine rows from two or more tables based on a related column

questions.explanation: JOIN combines rows from tables using a related column. Filtering uses WHERE, grouping uses GROUP BY and sorting uses ORDER BY.

questions.question: The primary protocol used for browsing the World Wide Web is:
questions.explanation: HTTP (and HTTPS) transfers web pages between browsers and servers. FTP transfers files, SMTP sends email and SNMP manages networks.

questions.question: Which data structure is most efficient for finding the minimum or maximum element?
questions.explanation: A min-heap or max-heap keeps the minimum or maximum at the root, giving O(1) lookup.

questions.question: A Turing Machine can recognise which class of languages?
questions.explanation: Turing machines recognise recursively enumerable languages, which include all regular, context-free and context-sensitive languages.

questions.question: CSS stands for:
questions.explanation: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets, used to style HTML documents.

questions.question: The number of bits in an IPv4 address is:
questions.explanation: An IPv4 address is 32 bits long (four octets). IPv6 addresses are 128 bits.

questions.question: "A NAND gate is a universal gate because any Boolean function can be implemented using only NAND gates." This statement is:
questions.explanation: NAND (and NOR) are universal gates since NOT, AND and OR can all be built from them, so any Boolean function can be implemented.

questions.question: Depth-First Search (DFS) of a graph typically uses which data structure?
questions.explanation: DFS uses a stack (explicitly or via recursion). BFS uses a queue.

questions.question: A queue data structure follows which principle?
questions.explanation: A queue inserts at the rear and removes from the front, following FIFO. A stack follows LIFO.

questions.question: A "page fault" occurs when:

options.D: A process tries to access a page that is not in main memory

questions.explanation: A page fault is raised when a referenced page is not present in physical memory, so the OS must load it from secondary storage.

questions.question: The PRIMARY KEY constraint on a column ensures:

options.A: Only that each value in the column is unique
options.B: That the column refers to another table's key
options.C: Only that the column cannot have NULL values
options.D: That each value is unique and the column cannot have NULL values

questions.explanation: A primary key combines UNIQUE and NOT NULL, so every value must be unique and non-null. Referring to another table is a FOREIGN KEY.

questions.question: The TCP protocol provides which of the following services?
questions.explanation: TCP is connection-oriented (three-way handshake), reliable (acknowledgements, retransmission) and provides flow control (sliding window) as well as congestion control.

questions.question: Agile software development is a methodology that emphasises:

options.D: A single final delivery at the end of the project

questions.explanation: Agile values working software, customer collaboration and responding to change, delivering in short iterations with frequent feedback.

questions.question: "Polymorphism allows objects of different classes to be treated as objects of a common superclass." This statement is:
questions.explanation: Through polymorphism, a superclass reference can refer to objects of any subclass, and the overridden method of the actual object is called.

questions.question: "Deep learning" is a subfield of machine learning that is based on:
questions.explanation: Deep learning uses artificial neural networks with many hidden layers to learn hierarchical representations.

questions.question: An operating system is a type of:
questions.explanation: The OS is system software that manages hardware and provides services to application programs.

questions.question: The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) in a CPU performs:
questions.explanation: The ALU performs arithmetic (add, subtract) and logical (AND, OR, NOT, compare) operations. Instruction decoding is done by the control unit.

questions.question: The GET request method in HTTP should ideally be used for:
questions.explanation: GET is a safe, idempotent method meant for retrieving resources. POST creates, PUT/PATCH modify and DELETE removes resources.

questions.question: A blockchain is essentially a:
questions.explanation: A blockchain is a decentralised, distributed ledger where blocks are cryptographically linked, making recorded data tamper-resistant.
